studyGuide.name: Comprehensive Exam Preparation Plan - Basic to Advanced
studyGuide.description: A structured, priority-wise plan covering all subjects for exam preparation. Topics are ordered logically for optimal learning.

subjects.subject: DSA
subjects.description: The foundation for coding interviews and problem-solving. Mastery is crucial.

topics.name: Arrays
tips: Master basic operations first. Focus on problems involving traversal, searching, and two-pointer techniques.

topics.name: Strings
tips: Practice string manipulation and pattern matching. Understand immutability in Java.

topics.name: Linked Lists
tips: Draw diagrams for pointer manipulation. Master reversing, cycles, and merges.

topics.name: Stacks and Queues
tips: Understand LIFO vs FIFO. Practice problems like 'Next Greater Element' and 'Sliding Window'.

topics.name: Recursion & Backtracking
tips: Start with simple problems like Fibonacci. Visualize the recursion tree for backtracking.

topics.name: Binary Trees & BST
tips: Memorize all traversal orders (In, Pre, Post, Level). Practice BST validation and operations.

topics.name: Graphs
tips: Master BFS and DFS implementations. Then move to Shortest Path (Dijkstra) and MST algorithms.

topics.name: Heap / Priority Queue
tips: Understand min-heap vs max-heap. Essential for problems asking for 'Top K' or 'Kth Largest' elements.

topics.name: Trie
tips: Crucial for string-based search problems. Practice 'Auto-complete' and 'Word Search' type problems.

topics.name: Dynamic Programming
tips: **HIGH PRIORITY FOR EXAMS**. Follow Striver's DP series order. Start with Fibonacci, then 0/1 Knapsack, LCS, etc. Practice identifying patterns.

subjects.subject: Java
subjects.description: Core language skills and modern frameworks. Important for backend development roles.

topics.name: Basic Syntax & OOP
tips: Solidify OOP principles: Inheritance, Polymorphism, Encapsulation, Abstraction. Write small programs to demonstrate each.

topics.name: Collections Framework
tips: Know the hierarchy. Understand when to use ArrayList vs LinkedList, HashMap vs TreeMap.

topics.name: Exception Handling
tips: Understand checked vs unchecked exceptions. Practice try-with-resources.

topics.name: Multithreading
tips: Focus on synchronization, volatile keyword, and producer-consumer problem.

topics.name: Streams API
tips: Think in terms of map, filter, and reduce. Practice converting traditional loops into streams.

topics.name: Spring Framework
tips: **EXAM FAVORITE**. Understand Dependency Injection, Spring Boot starters, and building a simple REST API.

subjects.subject: DCN
subjects.description: Fundamental knowledge of how networks operate. Key for system design roles.

topics.name: Network Fundamentals & OSI Model
tips: Memorize the 7 layers and their responsibilities. Understand the data flow from application to physical.

topics.name: TCP/IP Protocol Suite
tips: **EXAM CRITICAL**. Know the 3-way handshake, 4-way termination, and flow control mechanisms inside out.

topics.name: Routing Algorithms
tips: Differentiate between Distance Vector (RIP) and Link State (OSPF) algorithms.

topics.name: Error Detection and Correction
tips: Know how checksum and CRC work conceptually.

subjects.subject: DAPY
subjects.description: Essential for data analysis, manipulation, and visualization tasks.

topics.name: NumPy Arrays
tips: Focus on array creation, indexing, slicing, and universal functions (ufuncs).

topics.name: Pandas DataFrames
tips: Master data selection (.loc, .iloc), grouping (groupby), and handling missing data (isna, dropna, fillna).

topics.name: Data Visualization
tips: Learn to use Matplotlib for basic plots and Seaborn for statistical plots.

topics.name: Data Cleaning
tips: This is 80% of a data scientist's job. Practice on messy real-world datasets from Kaggle.

subjects.subject: AI
subjects.description: Broad concepts. Focus on fundamentals unless applying for AI-specific roles.

topics.name: Machine Learning Basics
tips: Differentiate between Supervised, Unsupervised, and Reinforcement Learning. Understand overfitting.

topics.name: Neural Networks & Deep Learning
tips: Focus on the intuition behind gradient descent and backpropagation, not just the math.

subjects.subject: WT
subjects.description: Full-stack development knowledge. Important for web developer roles.

topics.name: CSS Styling
tips: **CRITICAL**. Master Flexbox and CSS Grid. They are fundamental to modern layout design.

topics.name: JavaScript Basics
tips: Understand asynchronous JavaScript (Callbacks, Promises, Async/Await) for handling API calls.

topics.name: Frontend Frameworks (React)
tips: Understand components, props, state, and hooks (especially useState and useEffect).

generalExamTips: **Priority Order:** Follow the subject priority (DSA -> Java -> DCN -> ...). Spend your time accordingly.
**Active Learning:** Don't just watch videos. For every hour of video, spend 2-3 hours coding and solving problems.
**Revision:** Revise a topic every 48 hours and then again every week to move it to long-term memory.
**Mock Tests:** Closer to the exam, take as many timed mock tests as possible to build speed and accuracy.
**Focus on Weaknesses:** Identify your weak topics from the difficulty ratings and allocate more time to them.
